configs.description: C1300-24T-4G - 24 10/100/1000 ports and four 1 Gigabit SFP uplink cages, a built-in AC supply and no fan. The box holds the 19-inch brackets, the power cord (unless the NO-POWER-CORD option is ordered) and a pointer card.
configs.name: base

gaps.note: The data sheet says the 19-inch brackets ship with the switch and holds no figure of them, no position and no part number. No Catalyst 1300 installation guide is held. The ears are declared with the default position and no `at`, and no kit is listed.
gaps.wanted: The Catalyst 1300 hardware installation guide's rack-mounting section.

gaps.note: The data sheet lists the LEDs "System, Link/Act, PoE, Speed" and nothing more; no document held says which lamp shows what, where the PoE and Speed lamps are, or whether the arrows by the ports are the Link/Act lamps. The arrows and the System lamp carry the component's own vocabulary and no meaning is stated.

The data sheet names a USB Type-C port and no Type-A; the NetBox elevation shows a Type-A port above the RJ-45 jack and NetBox lists a USB-A console. The Type-A port is drawn from the elevation as a USB port, not a console. Its generation is not stated.

The antenna pictogram over the cages and the lock pictogram under the rear slot are drawn as outlines from the elevations (estimated: the elevations are about 5.5 px per mm and the symbols a few millimetres across). The rear's thin printed outlines are not drawn; what the pictograms mean is not stated in any held document.
Cisco's series page lists the model with no end-of-sale notice when the sources were gathered; no end-of-life page was held, so none is quoted.

gaps.wanted: `attrs.platform.cpu` (profile `networking` - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml) - unlocks the About panel, and comparison against other devices
`physical-context` on port groups rj45, sfp - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays

built-in-power-and-fans.note: "100-240V 50-60 Hz, internal, universal" (p33): the supply is built into the chassis, part of it and not a bay. The C1300-24T-4G is fanless (p34), so no fan is drawn and no fan bay is declared; the rear elevation shows none. The data sheet states no fan redundancy. NetBox types the power port iec-60320-c14, maximum draw 15 W; the data sheet's worst case is 14.8 W.

chassis.note: 444.3 x 240 x 43.94 mm (17.49 x 9.45 x 1.73 in), data sheet p30, in its W x D x H order. 444.3 is the body: neither elevation shows ears. 1RU. Weight 2.63 kg (5.80 lb), p32.

console-and-usb.note: The data sheet (p25) lists "Cisco standard RJ-45 console port and USB Type C port" and one reset button, and calls the USB port the Type-C port on the front panel; its text on the Bluetooth dongle (p4) says the dongle "plugs into the USB port on the switch". THE ELEVATION SHOWS A USB TYPE-A PORT as well, the upper half of the stacked housing under a USB symbol, with the RJ-45 below it and the USB Type-C port to its left. NetBox lists three console ports: RJ-45, USB-C and USB-A. The Type-A port is drawn from the elevation as a USB port and not as a console; the Type-C port is the console. The blue strip under the three ports carries a console pictogram. The Type-A port's generation is not stated, so the white (USB 2.0) skin is used, which claims less than the blue one.

ears.note: "Only 24-and 48-port models include the 19-in mounting brackets with the switch" (p35, again p40) and the ordering table reads "Rack-mountable" (p36). No held document draws the brackets, gives their positions or a part number, so the shipped position is declared as the default with no `at`, no kit is listed and the ears are not drawn. The accessory table's RCKMNT-CMPCT-1K= is for the 8, 12 and 16 port models and is not this device's.

front-layout.note: From the NetBox front elevation at the scales in gate-1. Two beige jack plates 87.6 and 87.3 mm wide at 168.2 and 272.2 mm, top 8.7 mm, 26.5 mm tall. Six columns of two jacks in each on the registry's 13.97 mm pitch, the first jack at 170.3 mm and the seventh at 274.5 mm, a 20.28 mm gutter beyond the pitch. The cell tops read 9.5 and 23.9 mm, a 14.4 mm row step; the upper jacks show their keyway up and the lower their keyway down. The four SFP cages are 14.0 mm wide at a 19.0 mm step, centres 372.3, 391.3, 410.3 and 429.3 mm, centred 29.6 mm down, so the 14.5 x 10.0 registry cage is placed on those centres. The stacked housing at the left is 16.8 x 21.7 mm at 30.8, 13.0 mm. Its USB Type-A opening is centred 39.2, 17.2 mm and its RJ-45 opening 39.2, 29.3 mm; the registry parts are centred on those. The USB Type-C port reads 9.6 x 3.3 mm centred 23.1, 33.2 mm. The reset button is 4.1 mm across, centred 12.0, 31.0 mm. The colours are medians of the elevation: face #e7e6e6, plates #d2cac0, console strip #b5d5e3.

gate-1.note: FRONT. The elevation is 2479 x 253 px, aspect 9.80, against 444.3 / 43.94 = 10.11 for the body. The picture is cropped at its right edge (the metal runs to the last column) and carries about 5 px of margin at the left and 9 px of shadow and lip at the top and 3 px at the bottom. Its jacks, cages and legends stand at the same pixels as on the 24P's elevation, so the front is read at the same scale: the metal from x 5.5 to 2483 (the printed 444.3 mm, 5.58 px per mm, checked on the jack pitch, which steps 78.0 px, 13.98 mm against the registry's 13.97) and from y 9 to 250 (241 px for the printed 43.94 mm, 5.48 px per mm, 1.8% under the horizontal). Every front x is (px - 5.5) / 5.58 and every y is (px - 9) / 5.48; across the figures are good to about 0.2 mm, down to about 0.5 mm. The right edge of this picture lies 5 px inside the metal, so no x past 440 mm is read from it. REAR. The elevation is 2508 x 256 px, aspect 9.80. The metal runs from x 3 to 2485 (2482 px for the printed 444.3 mm, 5.586 px per mm) and from y 7 to 247 (240 px for 43.94 mm, 5.46 px per mm, 2.3% under the horizontal). Every rear x is (px - 3) / 5.586 and every y is (px - 7) / 5.46, good to about 0.2 mm across and 0.5 mm down. The inlet's housing reads 31.5 x 24.6 mm, which is not the registry's 28 x 20 opening, so the part is centred on the housing.

lamps.note: estimated - the elevation shows no lamp except the arrows. The data sheet's LED row (p25) lists "System, Link/Act, PoE, Speed" and no held document says where they are or what they show. The 28 grey arrows by the ports are drawn as the library's arrow lamps, and the faint two-gear pictogram under the reset button as the System lamp. The arrows are at 3.4 mm and 10.4 mm from the left of each column and 39.2 mm down; the cage arrows are centred under their cages.

logo.note: The Cisco logo and wordmark at 9.4 to 22.5 mm and 4.7 to 11.5 mm are not drawn; a logo-zone reserves the place. The printed "Catalyst 1300 Series" is drawn as plain text.

port-numbering.note: The elevation prints 1 and 12 at the ends of the first block's arrow row, 13 and 24 at the ends of the second's, and 25 and 28 at the ends of the uplinks, with an arrow for each port: an up arrow for the upper jack of a column and a down arrow for the lower. So the upper jack takes the odd number and the lower the even, and the numbers run along the columns from the left, 1 to 24, then the four cages 25 to 28. Only those six numerals are printed and drawn. NetBox names the interfaces GigabitEthernet1 to 28 and types the four cages 1000base-x-sfp; no Cisco document held gives interface names, so none is written as an `interfaces:` block. The elevation has no PoE strip, bracket or legend, as it has no PoE.

power-use.note: Power consumption (worst case), p21: system 14.6 W at 110 V and 14.8 W at 220 V; "N/A" with PoE; 50.5 BTU/hr; idle 4.9 W at 110 V and 5.2 W at 220 V.

rear-layout.note: From the NetBox rear elevation. The C14 inlet's black housing is 31.5 x 24.6 mm centred 402.1, 21.6 mm, with the printed rating "AC INPUT RATING: / 100-240V~ / 700mA, 50-60Hz" in three lines centred 402.1 mm under it. At the left a security-lock slot 3.0 x 7.1 mm at 6.4, 14.5 mm with a lock pictogram under it, and four screws at x 7.7, 106.2, 264.2 and 434.8 mm, 34.6 mm down. The picture also shows an angled end plate at each side, a white clip above the inlet, a few thin printed outlines and two notches by the end plates; they are not drawn. The rear shows no vent, no fan and no label.

sources.note: "Cisco Catalyst 1300 and 1300X Series Switches" data sheet, Cisco public, (c) 2026, document 3659554-09, 41 pages (https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/collateral/switches/catalyst-1300-series-switches/nb-06-cat1300-ser-data-sheet-cte-en.pdf): the physical table (p25), power use (p21), dimensions (p30-31), weights (p32), power, operating temperature and certifications (p33), fans and MTBF (p34), package contents (p35) and the ordering table (p36-37). The NetBox device type C1300-24T-4G and its front and rear elevations cisco-c1300-24t-4g.front.png and cisco-c1300-24t-4g.rear.png, community files and not Cisco's. No Catalyst 1300 installation guide, no photograph of a single SKU and no 3D model is held. The data sheet's family photograph is unlabelled and is not used.
